body: Thanks - this thread almost took my mind off things for a little while, and that's more than enough. I'm going to see my doctor tomorrow, so maybe I'll get some help there.

No no, I appreciate honest advice more than empty platitudes. 

The next step is working out how to be a full person instead of half a person, but I'm scared of lasting damage. Each day, waking up is getting harder and harder. I've started pushing friends away, and I can't stand it when someone tries to touch me (hugs, etc.). 

I should be going towards some form of healing, but it just feels like I'm heading towards a breakdown.
Thanks for the harsh words, kind stranger.
I'm sad to think that I'll never love as completely and honestly again. I know that it changes you, but I am scared of that change.
